identify: Small hopping insects sit at the base of the rice plant, near the water.
The brown planthopper and the white-backed planthopper are major rice pests in India.
damage: They suck sap at the plant base. Heavy attack dries the plants in round patches.

thresholds.etl: Tillering: 10-15 hoppers/hill. Panicle initiation to booting: 15-20 hoppers/hill.

cultural: Check the base of the plants every few days.
Split the nitrogen fertilizer into smaller doses.
biological: Protect spiders and mirid bugs in the field. They eat planthoppers.

cultural: Drain the field for 3 to 4 days.
Do not use high doses of nitrogen fertilizer.
biological: Protect spiders and mirid bugs in the field. They eat planthoppers.

cultural: Drain the field for 3 to 4 days.

safety: Spray only when the pest count crosses the threshold. Wear gloves and a mask when you spray.

stage_notes.vegetative: Act when you count 10-15 hoppers per hill.
stage_notes.flowering: Act when you count 15-20 hoppers per hill.
